guide_solution: Completing sentences (a) Truthfulness is a great virtue because it leads us to the path of truth. (b) One cannot command the respect of others unless one does the same towards others. (c) One may succeed once or twice by telling a lie but it gets exposed sooner or later. (d) Nobody will trust you if you are a liar. (e) So, it is a wise decision to farm the habit of speaking the truth.
